label: Prize and Barrier
line: Open on the prize as a number, keep it in view, and hold the barrier back to about two thirds so it lands as the reason.
best_for: a 'why do we not have this yet' topic
a limit with a number behind it: a cost, a temperature, a distance, an error rate
also_for: a technology that works in one place and nowhere else
avoid_for: a barrier that is only money or politics, with no figure
a prize the viewer does not want
a problem already solved: the barrier must still stand
signals: something valuable exists and is not being used
the size of the prize is a number
one barrier with a number explains why

beats.name: The prize
beats.job: The size of it as a number, against something the viewer knows.

beats.name: However
beats.job: One line: getting it is not easy.

beats.name: The lucky exception
beats.job: Where it already works, and why there. End on the tease as one image.

beats.name: The more, the better
beats.job: What improves as the effort grows, with a number.

beats.name: The barrier
beats.job: The cost or the limit that grows with it, as a number.

beats.name: Who is trying
beats.job: Who is working on it, or what would have to change.

hooks.shape: [Untapped thing] holds [huge number]. Just [tiny fraction] of it could [benefit].
If [prize] is right there, why is nobody using it?
[Thing] is everywhere and almost free, and we still cannot [use it].

holds: The prize stays in view while the barrier is held back, so the viewer keeps asking why not. The exception shows it is possible, which makes the barrier a real answer when it comes.
ending: Who is trying to change it, or what would have to change. No promise about when.
pitfalls: Opening on the cost or the difficulty
Reasons joined by 'also' with no single barrier
template: [Untapped thing] holds [huge number]. Just [tiny fraction] could [benefit]. But getting to it is not easy. [One place where it works]. [The tease as one image]. The more [x], the better: [number]. The problem is [barrier], because [the cost that grows]. [Who is trying].
